$docs.identity: slug is the tenant key everywhere (folder name, brands.slug, onboarding); bundleId/scheme and kioskBundleId/kioskScheme feed the per-brand Expo configs; easProjectId and kioskEasProjectId come from each binary's separate `eas init`.
$docs.tokens: Hydrated into packages/ui's ThemeProvider and stored on brands.brand_config. Colors are #RRGGBB. fontDisplay/fontBody must be family names from the supported font registry (maintained in packages/ui/src/font-registry.ts, landing in the next phase). Optional tokens.ramp holds advanced overrides for the app's internal palette, keyed exactly like the legacy `colors` export -- note ramp.surface is the app screen surface, distinct from top-level tokens.surface used by splash/shared components; when omitted, the steps are derived from the seed colors by the theme resolver. Derive the palette from the brand's own assets -- never from any other product's look (docs/DO-NOT-RESEMBLE.md).
$docs.copy: Every user-facing brand string. Keys the apps read are listed in packages/ui/src/copy.ts (DEFAULT_COPY); unknown keys are allowed and ignored. {placeholders} survive until formatted.
$docs.features: Rule 5 flags, mirrored to the brands row by onboarding.
$docs.fees: Rule 3: platform take in basis points; above tierThresholdCents of gross in a calendar month (per location) later payments use feeBpsTier2. Confirm per contract before onboarding.
$docs.locations: Canonical location list created by onboarding. hours uses 24h HH:MM in each location's timezone; [] = closed.
$docs.illustrations: Optional named palettes for brand illustration work (e.g. the rewards cup). Free-form; read by the app's illustration components.
$docs.business: Contact + legal identity the apps print (error screens, receipts, calendar notes, gift codes). monogram is the 1-3 letter fallback mark; giftCodePrefix prefixes every issued gift code.
$docs.modifiers.json: Sibling file: option groups per item slug, in the JSONB shape packages/engine/src/menu-pricing.ts reads -- each slug maps to an array of groups {id, name, select: 'single' | 'multi', required, maxChoices, dependsOn?, choices: [{id, name, priceDeltaCents}]}. Optional; items absent from it sell plain. Every key must be a slug in menu.csv -- onboarding validates that.

kiosk.$docs: The container family: the sellable SKU is a box and the guest allocates its slots. Exercises migration 0029's pack path.
kiosk.$idleDocs: Longer than Coffee Story's: filling a box takes longer than picking one latte, and a reset mid-box is the worst thing a container kiosk can do.
